show.description: Luck can strike anyone, at any time, in unexpected ways. On that day, a delivery boy received a phone call—and his life changed forever. But along with the fortune, troubles began to follow. This is the story of a delivery boy who struggles to understand how to embrace sudden luck when it arrives all at once.
